panels.notes: Dark edit room. Monitor is the only light. Alex small in frame. Opening image.
Clip 01: empty street at dusk. Plays 4s too long — stillness is the hook.
Alex frowns. Monitor glow on face. Inciting moment.
Zoom 400%: figure under streetlight, facing lens. Barely human-shaped, degraded.
Clip 02: parking lot. Same figure. Closer. Same stance.
Metadata: Created TODAY 11:58 PM. Wall clock reads 11:54. The impossible detail.
Clip 03: figure mid-ground. Face = compression artifacts. Hold uncomfortably.
Hand hovers over Clip 04. Shallow focus. The choice. Slowest cut in the film.
Clip 04: HIS hallway. Figure at the far end. Geography collapses — the footage is here.
Alex turns to the REAL doorway: empty. Match Shot 9 composition exactly.
Monitor now shows a LIVE feed of this room from behind his chair.
On-screen: the figure steps into frame behind the chair. One clean step. No sting.
His eyes lift to the dead monitor's bezel — reflected silhouette behind him. He knows.
Same frame as Shot 1. Monitor light dies. Black. Final image mirrors opening — room now occupied.
